name: Bluggy
description: Beloved by herbalists in winter, these resilient Bluggies lie nestled among frost-covered forageables, warming them just enough to break through the snow.

name: Alpheep
description: A fluffy, cloud-shaped grazer known for its faintly luminous wool. Travels in small flocks and bleats only when startled.

name: Girtle
description: A patient, long-lived reptile whose mossy shell often hides tiny gardens of fern and clover that grow undisturbed for years.

name: Chikree
description: A small, plucky ground bird with sun-warm plumage. Chirps in quick bursts and is fond of stealing dropped grain from carts.
